video_prompt_overlay: NICHE VISUAL LOCK (Vanished Without Trace / mystery): Generate a 7–9 second dialogue clip based on the topic `{topic}`. Each dialogue must feel like an investigation log. For each dialogue, generate: - **Audio Generation Prompt:** Voice — neutral, investigative, with static radio or sonar beeps. - **Video Generation Prompt:** Detailed visual — empty ocean, or a deserted ship interior. No characters — just objects (half-eaten meal, open logbook). Lighting: grey, overcast, flat. Maintain the same maritime environment, same grey tones, same slow camera drift.
